_readme: SGR-024 subject groups. Each PubMed record's MeSH major-topic descriptors are looked up in the MeSH 2026 tree (mesh-trees.tsv, built by mesh-trees.py). A tree number is mapped to a group by its first three characters if listed under 'overrides', else by its first character under 'defaults'. A descriptor votes 1 in total, split equally over the distinct groups its tree numbers fall in. A JOURNAL is given the group with the most votes among its included records entered 2015-01 to 2022-11 (before ChatGPT), if that group has at least 40% of the journal's votes and the journal has at least 10 votes in all; otherwise 'general' (10 or more votes, no dominant group) or 'unclassified' (fewer than 10 votes, which includes journals with no MeSH indexing). The groups are a rough stratification of journals, not a classification of articles.
